business_rules.name: Supported Arithmetic Operations
business_rules.description: The calculator supports exactly four arithmetic operations: Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, and Division
business_rules.validation: Enforced by UI selectbox - only predefined options available

business_rules.name: Division by Zero Prohibition
business_rules.description: Division operation with second number equal to zero is not permitted. The application displays an error and halts execution.
business_rules.error_message: Division by zero is not allowed.
business_rules.enforcement: Explicit guard clause with st.stop() to halt script execution
business_rules.recovery: User must enter a non-zero second number and resubmit form

business_rules.name: Numeric Input Precision
business_rules.description: Both numeric inputs accept floating-point numbers displayed to 6 decimal places
business_rules.code_snippet:
num1 = st.number_input('First number', value=0.0, format='%.6f')
num2 = st.number_input('Second number', value=0.0, format='%.6f')
business_rules.range: No explicit min/max constraints - full float range

business_rules.name: Form Submission Triggers Calculation
business_rules.description: Calculation only executes when the user explicitly clicks the 'Calculate' submit button. Changing inputs does not trigger recalculation.
business_rules.code_snippet:
with st.form('calculator_form'):
    ...
    submitted = st.form_submit_button('Calculate')
if submitted:
business_rules.pattern: st.form batches all inputs - prevents reactive per-keystroke re-runs

business_rules.name: Result Display Format
business_rules.description: Successful calculation results are displayed in the format: '{num1} {symbol} {num2} = {result}'

business_rules.name: Computation Details Availability
business_rules.description: After each successful calculation, a collapsible panel provides a structured breakdown of all computation parameters
business_rules.code_snippet:
with st.expander('Computation details'):
    st.write({'first_number': num1, 'second_number': num2, 'operation': operation, 'result': result})

business_rules.name: Stateless Operation
business_rules.description: The application maintains no state between sessions or between calculations. Each calculation is independent with no history.
business_rules.enforcement: No st.session_state usage; Streamlit re-runs entire script on each interaction
business_rules.implication: Users cannot reference previous calculation results

business_rules.name: Default Input Values
business_rules.description: Both number inputs default to 0.0 on page load and after each re-render

business_rules.name: Page Configuration
business_rules.description: The browser tab displays 'Calculator' as page title with a calculator emoji icon. The layout is centered.

summary.key_constraint: Division by zero is the only input validation rule enforced by the application
